subject: Spring Demo Series — promo codes & tracking plan
messages:
From: Emma Reynolds <emma@eventco.com>
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 14 Mar 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Promo codes for Spring Demo Series?

Hi Neha,

Hope you’re well — EventCo is running a short Spring Demo Series (three regional webinars in Apr–May) and we’d love to offer attendees an easy way to try Redwood. Would Redwood be able to provide promo codes for trial extensions / free credits that we can distribute to registrants?

High-level ask:
- ~200 single-use promo codes for webinar registrants (across the three sessions)
- Prefer codes to grant a 30–45 day trial extension or $50 credit — open to your recommendation
- We need simple redemption tracking (which registrant redeemed which code) for reporting back to sponsors

Attached is a one-pager about the series and audience breakdown. Can you share the process, constraints (expiration, per-account limits), and an ETA if this is possible? We aim to finalize promo details by next Wed, 18 Mar.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if easier.

Best,
Emma Reynolds
Events Manager, EventCo
emma@eventco.com
Attachment: event_brief.pdf (1.2MB)
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Reynolds <emma@eventco.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 14 Mar 2026 12:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Promo codes for Spring Demo Series?

Hi Emma — thanks for the brief and the invite. This is doable, and I’ve looped in Ben (Sales Ops) and Laura (Partner Marketing) to align on allocation and tracking. Quick notes / questions from my side: 

- Are you expecting the codes to be single-use or multi-use? We typically do single-use to avoid double-redemptions.
- Do you want the credit to be a time-based trial extension (e.g., +30/45 days) or a dollar credit? We’ll need to pick one for accounting.
- Do you want us to reserve unique code pools per session or a single pool for all three?

Ben/Laura — can you weigh in on available code formats, budget cap, and whether we should make extension 30 vs 45 days for demo attendees? Emma aims to lock by 18 Mar.

Neha Kapoor
Partnerships, Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 15 Mar 2026 09:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Promo codes for Spring Demo Series?

Neha / Laura — OK from Sales Ops to provide 200 single-use codes. A few operational details: 

- Code format: RDWD-XXXX-YYYY (we can generate a CSV and upload to EventCo permitted redemption endpoint).
- Redemption tracking: we can attach a unique redemption id per code; EventCo will need to include registrant email at redemption or we can provide a one-time registration URL for each code to capture that mapping.
- Trial extension vs dollar credit: accounting prefers dollar-equivalent credits for clarity. $50 credit is fine; however, if we offer a 45-day extension instead, we should estimate the expected spend.
- Budget cap: recommend capping liability at ~$3,000 for the campaign (we can set an aggregated cap in our promo backend).

I’ll create a promo_codes_template.csv and a short instructions doc for EventCo. Attaching a template now.

Ben Carter
Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
Attachment: promo_codes_template.csv
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 15 Mar 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Promo codes for Spring Demo Series?

Love this — quick marketing ask to optimize conversion:

- Split: reserve 150 codes for our newsletter (we’ll promote the webinar + exclusive code) and 50 codes for EventCo direct registrants. That helps attribution.
- Incentive: recommend 45-day trial for the demo series (more runway to build value) instead of a straight $50 credit — historically higher activation. If Ops prefers $50 credit we’ll take that, but please note conversion delta.
- Expiry: set code expiry to 2026-06-30 so users have time to redeem post-webinar.
- Tracking: we’ll maintain a shared Google Sheet with code-to-channel mapping; can EventCo confirm they’ll capture registrant emails at redemption or we’ll use unique landing URLs.

Neha — can you confirm split + expiration + per-account redemption limit (1 per account)? I’ll prepare the marketing copy and UTM parameters once confirmed.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Partner Marketing, Redwood Inference
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Reynolds <emma@eventco.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 18 Mar 2026 16:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Promo codes for Spring Demo Series? — confirmed allocation & next steps

Hi Emma — thanks for your patience. Confirming details and next steps below so we can close by EOD Wed (18 Mar):

Confirmed plan:
- Total codes: 200 single-use promo codes
- Split: 150 codes reserved for Redwood newsletter distribution, 50 codes allocated to EventCo registrant pool
- Offer: 45-day trial extension (preferred by marketing) — redemption limit: 1 per Redwood account
- Expiry: 2026-06-30
- Liability cap: $3,000 (Sales Ops will enforce aggregated cap in the promo backend)

Operational items we’ve completed/offered: 
- Sales Ops (Ben) created a promo_codes_template.csv and will generate the 200 single-use codes on Tuesday 24 Mar.
- We’ll provide a sheet mapping code -> channel (Laura will manage the sheet): https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1aBbExample
- Recommended redemption flow: registrants click a unique landing URL (per-channel) and redeem with their EventCo email so we have mapping. If EventCo prefers, we can provide codes directly and EventCo can attach registrant emails on redemption — please confirm which you prefer.
- Promo upload link: https://app.redwood.ai/promo/EVT-9843 (Sales Ops will post generated CSV here for EventCo retrieval).

Attachments: once codes are generated we’ll attach spring-demo-codes.csv to the shared sheet. For now I’m attaching the template and the original event brief for reference.

Next steps for EventCo:
1) Confirm whether you want per-channel landing URLs or direct code distribution (reply to this thread).
2) Share target launch dates for each regional session so we can prioritize code generation.

If that looks good, I’ll mark this approved and Ben will generate the codes next week. Thanks everyone — looking forward to a great series.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Partnerships, Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Attachments: spring-demo-codes.csv (to be produced), promo_codes_template.csv, event_brief.pdf
